### Summary:
Prioritize buying [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f).
If you have >$6k afterwards, buy [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), otherwise just buy [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242).

### Round 3 Power

For round 3 power, choose [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3) if you chose [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b) in round 1 or vice versa. These are going to be your core powers, and will go a long way in ensuring your team has enough heals and still give you plenty of flexibility in your play-style.

### Summary:
Your experience in the first 2 rounds should begin to dictate how you structure your round 3 purchases where we'll look at your first purple. If you're finding an easy time staying alive and can afford it, [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) is a great pick for your first purple with 10% Weapon Power and 10% Cool-down reduction. If you can't afford it without selling [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f)  it's not worth it. If you have [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), you can opt to trade it out for [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) in case you just need a little extra cash.

If you are either struggling to stay alive or save critical teammates, you can go [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) instead, which adds a decent chunk of healing with your Suzu saves. If you're short on cash, take a look at the situational items below.

**Situational**
[Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) is a more generic survivability pick. While the temporary overhealth isn't game-changing, it gives an additional 5% CDR which helps a lot. Another great generic pick for survivability is [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016), which just converts 100 of your health to armor, so you shouldn't get bursted down as quickly. [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) *can* be sold to get any of these items, but if you're struggling to stay alive, try to avoid selling if you can.

[Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f) is good if you are facing off against an annoying [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000), [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49), [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a), [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b). This will reduce the time you spent stunned if you're not able to get Suzu off consistently.

[Iron Eyes](item_f16d03a7-f20e-4a1d-a1f6-55863e163c03) is a good survivability boost if you're facing off against a good [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b), [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54), or [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) and are finding yourself bursted down by headshots.

### Summary:
Find a balance between keeping yourself and your team alive while still being able to find opportunities to get a few eliminations. Unless you opted for survivability items on round 3, you should be pretty squishy at this point and will want to opt for something to help you stay alive. Selfish pick is [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc), Balanced pick is [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718), or selfless pick [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b).

If you're steamrolling, can opt for [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40) instead to really crank up damage and normal healing output

### Powers
[Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663) is my default pick here as the enemy's builds really take form in round 5.
[Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) is a fun pick, but only works well when combined with [Ryōta’s Reloader](item_5cabe555-3845-49fa-9941-71b870c2c164)

### Summary:
You'll likely have been short on cash for this build up to this point, this is your chance to catch up. If you have extra cash, either fill 6th slot with [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) or [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da), or sell [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) in favor of any of the optional items.

If you chose [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) over [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663), pick up [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) or [Ryōta’s Reloader](item_5cabe555-3845-49fa-9941-71b870c2c164).

If you picked up [Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f) earlier, [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) is a good alternative to counter sleep darts. 

If you just want more damage or healing output with Healing Ofuda, you can go [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40) (best for spread out team), [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) (best if you land a lot of headshots, or [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) (best for playing cleanup crew)

### Summary:
[The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) can be substituted with [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) or [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40). If you choose [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40), having [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) can be a bit redundant, but still useful for the 10% weapon power if you don't have enough cash for [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) or [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b).

If doing [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657), sub [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) for [Ryōta’s Reloader](item_5cabe555-3845-49fa-9941-71b870c2c164).

Consider [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) if you still need more survivability or feel like you're doing plenty of damage already as a substitute for [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) or [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242), as [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) scales with it and provides you a little extra CDR.

### Power
[Keen Kunai](item_d5993121-8a5f-4c59-9145-19dc55265f48) is a phenomenal final pick for power as it massively boost cooldown reduction and lets you spam Suzu. If you go this route, it allows you to finally sell [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f). Pairs really well with [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) if you chose that on round 5.

Other viable alternatives are [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663) for survivability or [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) if you want to hand the baton off to your team.

###Summary:
By this point, you should be a true force of nature. While the enemies may have also massively boosted their health and damage, you should still be having the time of your life. Spam suzu, be up in people's faces, and stick with your team, and try to stay focused in the frenzy known as round 7.

If you chose [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) in round 5 and [Keen Kunai](item_d5993121-8a5f-4c59-9145-19dc55265f48) in round 7, [Ryōta’s Reloader](item_5cabe555-3845-49fa-9941-71b870c2c164) is now optional. 

If you have extra cash, go for [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) or [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b). Either is a valid 6th item pick as [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) reduces enemy TTK on you by 15% and [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) gives an extra hand to your team as you're swift stepping around during fights.

If you're short on cash, replace [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) with any of the optional items from previous rounds, or consider selling [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and/or [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) in order to get the Epics that you need.
